raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
**Merge after #<PR1>** (`fix(engine): restore aiter MoE weight layout after online weight updates`).
The sglang variant runs that PR's `areal.engine.sglang_aiter_moe_layout` at build time. On this
branch alone, `VARIANT=vllm` builds, while `VARIANT=sglang` stops with
`No module named areal.engine.sglang_aiter_moe_layout`.

### Key changes

- `FROM rocm/primus:v26.5` (ROCm 7.15, torch 2.12, Transformer Engine, aiter, flash-attn). The base
  image's ROCm torch is never replaced, and the last build step fails if `torch.version.hip` is unset.
- The engine pins match `Dockerfile`: SGLang `v0.5.10.post1` and vLLM `v0.19.1`, both built from
  source for ROCm. `torch_memory_saver` (`118b09b`, whose HIP VMM fix is not in a tag yet),
  Megatron-LM `core_v0.19.0` and mbridge are also built from source.
- vLLM cherry-picks vllm#41802 (`6881c754e1`, released in v0.21.0). It fixes `call to atomicAdd is
  ambiguous` in the GPTQ kernels on ROCm >= 7.13. Drop it once AReaL pins vLLM >= 0.21.0.
- `requirements-rocm.txt` pins the shared Python dependencies. They are installed `--no-deps` because
  `pyproject.toml` requires `torch<2.11`, so resolving it would replace the ROCm torch. That is also
  why this file cannot use `uv.lock`.
- Engine source trees are removed after installation, as in the CUDA image.
- Runtime overrides of values baked into the base image (each one is commented in the file):
  - `GPU_ARCHS=gfx942`: aiter cannot resolve the base's `native` and would JIT for gfx906.
  - `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` replaced rather than appended: the base ships two libLLVM copies, and loading
    both aborts torch_memory_saver and Transformer Engine.
  - `NVTE_FLASH_ATTN=1 NVTE_FUSED_ATTN=1`: megatron-core's `attention_backend=auto` needs both.
  - `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1`: vLLM 0.19.1 serves `/sleep` and `/wake_up`, used by colocation, only in
    dev mode. Dev mode exposes unauthenticated debug endpoints, so do not publish the vLLM port.
  - `SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]`.

## Related Issue

Must be merged after #<PR1>. No upstream issue yet.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [x] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [x] I have read the
  [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (run on the changed files)
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality (AReaL has no AMD CI; manual runs below)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main` (based on `18f5271f`, 3 unrelated commits behind, merges cleanly)
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [ ] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

## Additional Context

### What was tested

All runs used AMD MI308X (gfx942).

**1. Images built from exactly this Dockerfile (with #<PR1> applied)**

- `VARIANT=sglang` and `VARIANT=vllm` both build. The import check prints
  `OK 2.12.0+rocm7.15.0a20260720 0.5.10.post1` and `OK 2.12.0+rocm7.15.0a20260720 0.19.1`.
- At runtime both images report `GPU_ARCHS=gfx942`, `PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=gfx942` and
  `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1`, and both engines import with `/sglang` and `/vllm` removed.
- In the sglang image, 5 of 5 `torch_memory_saver` VMM probes pass. They cover allocation, the
  `LD_PRELOAD` hook with and without a region, `TMS_INIT_ENABLE=1`, and pause/resume with CPU backup
  followed by `.item()`.

**2. End-to-end RL training on an image from this Dockerfile (`VARIANT=vllm`)**

The run used Qwen3-30B-A3B with FSDP2, vLLM 0.19.1, aiter MoE, CUDA graphs and real xccl weight
updates. It completed 4 of 4 steps with exit code 0, finite loss and live gradients. The mean
train-vs-rollout logprob difference was 0.030, and 0.16% of tokens were beyond ln 2. 

**3. RL training cases (8 × MI308X)**

Based on this PR [fix(engine): restore aiter MoE weight layout after online weight updates](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/pull/1834): FSDP and Megatron colocation offload, vLLM colocation server
arguments, vLLM disk-update wake-up, SGLang colocation weights, and an MoE expert-name fix. These
results show that the stack trains.

| Case | Model | Result |
|---|---|---|
| smoke: SGLang + FSDP2, separation | Qwen2.5-0.5B | pass |
| smoke: vLLM + FSDP2, colocation | Qwen2.5-0.5B | pass |
| smoke: SGLang + Megatron, colocation | Qwen2.5-0.5B | pass |
| smoke: vLLM + Megatron, separation | Qwen2.5-0.5B | pass |
| accuracy: SGLang + FSDP2, separation | Qwen2.5-Math-7B | pass, logprob diff 0.0188 |
| accuracy: vLLM + FSDP2, colocation | Qwen2.5-Math-7B | pass, logprob diff 0.0094 |
| accuracy: SGLang + Megatron, colocation | Qwen2.5-Math-7B | pass, logprob diff 0.0186 |
| accuracy: vLLM + Megatron, separation | Qwen2.5-Math-7B | pass, logprob diff 0.0095 |
| stability: SGLang + FSDP2, separation | Qwen3-30B-A3B | 120/120 steps, no OOM, hang or RCCL timeout; leak verdict inconclusive |

- **Smoke**: 3 steps at learning rate 0. It checks that the rollout weights are bit-identical to the
  trainer's after a sync (with a poisoned-weights negative control), and that a checkpoint saved
  after step 2 is loaded and training resumes at step 3.
- **Accuracy**: 20 steps, gated on the mean train-vs-rollout logprob difference (limit 0.2, at most 1%
  of tokens beyond ln 2). It does not prove convergence.
- **Stability**: no OOM, hang or RCCL timeout. 

### Not covered

- GPUs other than MI308X (gfx942). Other architectures need `--build-arg GPU_ARCH=...` and were not built.
- Other base images or ROCm versions, and upstream AMD CI (AReaL has no AMD runners).
- `requirements-rocm.txt` and the per-variant pins are maintained by hand and must follow `uv.lock`.

detail.title: feat(docker): add Dockerfile.rocm for AMD ROCm images

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+# AMD ROCm counterpart of Dockerfile. Supports sglang and vllm variants via the VARIANT build argument.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   docker build -f Dockerfile.rocm -t areal-runtime:dev-rocm-sglang .                        # default (sglang)
+#   docker build -f Dockerfile.rocm --build-arg VARIANT=vllm -t areal-runtime:dev-rocm-vllm .  # vllm variant
+#
+# Unlike Dockerfile, both variants keep the base image's ROCm torch: PyPI torch wheels are
+# CUDA-only, so every package below is installed --no-deps or compiled against that torch.
+# Validated on 8 x MI308X (gfx942), ROCm 7.15.
+
+FROM rocm/primus:v26.5
+
+SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
+
+# Inference backend selector: sglang (default) or vllm
+ARG VARIANT=sglang
+ARG GPU_ARCH=gfx942
+ARG SITE_PACKAGES=/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages
+
+# The base sets GPU_ARCHS=native, which aiter cannot resolve, so its JIT kernels would build for gfx906.
+ENV PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=${GPU_ARCH} \
+    AMDGPU_TARGET=${GPU_ARCH} \
+    GPU_ARCHS=${GPU_ARCH}
+
+##############################################################
+# Python dependencies (pure-Python delta versus the base image)
+##############################################################
+
+COPY requirements-rocm.txt /tmp/requirements-rocm.txt
+RUN pip install --no-deps --no-cache-dir --pre -r /tmp/requirements-rocm.txt \
+    && pip install --no-deps --no-cache-dir "uv_build>=0.9.18,<0.10.0"
+
+# amdsmi ships inside the ROCm SDK wheel; expose it as a top-level module.
+RUN ln -sfn "$(ls -d ${SITE_PACKAGES}/_rocm_sdk_*/share/amd_smi/amdsmi | head -1)" ${SITE_PACKAGES}/amdsmi
+
+##############################################################
+# Training stack
+##############################################################
+
+# torch memory saver, built for HIP. PR #112 (HIP VMM host access) is in no tag yet.
+RUN pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation --no-cache-dir \
+    git+https://github.com/fzyzcjy/torch_memory_saver.git@118b09b3bc7b0cf386745db1eac2601d4aa7e681
+
+RUN pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation --no-cache-dir \
+    git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git@core_v0.19.0 \
+    git+https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/mbridge.git@310e8fb35ccf4fcd4419d32973e563a6d43ee5fb
+
+##############################################################
+# Inference backend (variant-specific, built from source for ROCm)
+##############################################################
+
+# sglang: sgl-kernel via setup_rocm.py, then SGLang with its ROCm pyproject.
+RUN if [ "$VARIANT" = "sglang" ]; then \
+      pip install --no-deps --no-cache-dir \
+        airportsdata==20260905 asttokens==3.0.2 blobfile==3.0.0 executing==2.3.0 \
+        grpcio-health-checking==1.84.0 ipython==9.17.1 ipython_pygments_lexers==1.1.1 \
+        iree-base-compiler==3.8.0 iree-base-runtime==3.8.0 jedi==0.20.0 matplotlib-inline==0.2.2 \
+        modelscope-hub==0.4.6 modelscope==1.40.2 nest-asyncio==1.6.0 outlines==0.1.11 parso==0.8.7 \
+        petit_kernel==0.0.2 pexpect==4.9.0 ptyprocess==0.7.0 pure_eval==0.2.4 \
+        smg-grpc-proto==0.4.26 smg-grpc-servicer==0.13.6 stack-data==0.6.3 traitlets==5.16.1 \
+        wave-lang==3.8.2 \
+      && git clone --depth 1 -b v0.5.10.post1 https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git /sglang \
+      && cd /sglang/sgl-kernel && python setup_rocm.py install \
+      && cp /sglang/python/pyproject_other.toml /sglang/python/pyproject.toml \
+      && pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation --no-cache-dir /sglang/python \
+      && rm -rf /sglang; \
+    fi
+
+# vllm: built against the base torch. vllm#41802 (released in v0.21.0) fixes the ambiguous GPTQ
+# atomicAdd on ROCm >= 7.13; drop the cherry-pick once AReaL pins vllm >= 0.21.0.
+RUN if [ "$VARIANT" = "vllm" ]; then \
+      pip install --no-deps --no-cache-dir \
+        astor==0.8.1 blake3==1.0.11 cbor2==6.1.5 depyf==0.20.0 ijson==3.5.1 \
+        lm-format-enforcer==0.11.3 model-hosting-container-standards==0.1.16 \
+        opencv-python-headless==5.0.0.93 opentelemetry-exporter-http-transport==0.66b1 \
+        opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-common==0.66b1 opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common==1.45.1 \
+        opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-grpc==1.45.1 opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.45.1 \
+        opentelemetry-exporter-otlp==1.45.1 opentelemetry-semantic-conventions-ai==0.5.1 \
+        prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator==8.1.0 python-json-logger==4.2.0 supervisor==4.3.0 \
+        watchfiles==1.3.0 \
+      && git clone --depth 1 -b v0.19.1 https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git /vllm \
+      && cd /vllm \
+      && git fetch --depth 2 origin 6881c754e1ce4b154ad48e8532d4680e3a54096c \
+      && git cherry-pick --no-commit 6881c754e1ce4b154ad48e8532d4680e3a54096c \
+      && cd / \
+      && VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=rocm SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=0.19.1 \
+         pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation --no-cache-dir /vllm \
+      && rm -rf /vllm; \
+    fi
+
+##############################################################
+# Runtime environment (workarounds for values baked into the base image)
+##############################################################
+
+# One libLLVM: loading torch_memory_saver or transformer_engine otherwise aborts with
+# "spirv-expand-step registered more than once".
+ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${SITE_PACKAGES}/_rocm_sdk_core/lib:${SITE_PACKAGES}/_rocm_sdk_core/lib/llvm/lib:${SITE_PACKAGES}/_rocm_sdk_core/lib/host-math/lib:${SITE_PACKAGES}/_rocm_sdk_core/lib/rocm_sysdeps/lib:${SITE_PACKAGES}/_rocm_sdk_libraries/lib:/opt/openmpi/lib
+# The base sets NVTE_FLASH_ATTN=0; megatron-core's attention_backend=auto requires both on.
+ENV NVTE_FLASH_ATTN=1 NVTE_FUSED_ATTN=1
+# vLLM 0.19.1 serves /sleep and /wake_up, which colocation calls, only in dev mode. Dev mode also
+# exposes unauthenticated debug endpoints, so do not publish the vLLM port to untrusted networks.
+# SGLang ignores this variable.
+ENV VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1
+
+##############################################################
+# Install AReaL from local source (last for fast iteration)
+##############################################################
+
+COPY . /AReaL
+RUN pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation --no-cache-dir -e /AReaL
+
+# SGLang 0.5.10.post1 ROCm fix (aiter MoE layout on weight update); refuses any other SGLang source.
+RUN if [ "$VARIANT" = "sglang" ]; then cd / && python -m areal.engine.sglang_aiter_moe_layout; fi
+
+# Fail the build if the ROCm torch was replaced or a backend does not import.
+RUN cd / && python -c "import torch, areal, torch_memory_saver, megatron.core, mbridge, ${VARIANT}; \
+    assert torch.version.hip, torch.__version__; print('OK', torch.__version__, ${VARIANT}.__version__)"
+
+WORKDIR /AReaL
+ENTRYPOINT []
+CMD ["/bin/bash"]

@@ -0,0 +1,135 @@
+# Python dependencies for Dockerfile.rocm, shared by the sglang and vllm variants.
+# Installed with --no-deps so the base image ROCm torch is kept; pyproject.toml pins a CUDA torch
+# and sglang/vllm pull CUDA-only kernels. Pinned from the validated rocm/primus:v26.5 image.
